site.description: Solutions Architect and Certified Expert Site Reliability Engineer. Twenty years across customer-facing technical consulting and hands-on platform operations: Kubernetes, Terraform, multi-cloud, observability. Based in Costa Rica.

hero.lead: Twenty years on both sides of the table: scoping and designing systems with the people who pay for them, then running the platforms underneath in production. Based in Costa Rica.

about.heading: Approach
paragraphs: Seven of those twenty years were customer-facing. As Lead Solutions Architect at IBM I ran on-site requirement sessions with CIOs and technical stakeholders, designed hybrid and multi-cloud target architectures, presented and demoed them to executive and engineering audiences, and stayed with the work through implementation and handoff. At VMware I owned a cloud lab platform end to end — qualifying leads, running discovery calls, delivering live demos, guiding customers to the right subscription — while running the vSphere and NSX infrastructure the platform depended on.

The other side is production. Reliability engineering, SLOs and error budgets, observability, Infrastructure as Code, incident response, and cloud cost optimization across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. The reason both halves matter together: an architecture you have never operated is a guess, and a platform you cannot explain to the person funding it does not get funded.
Outside of delivery work I mentor engineers moving into reliability roles, and I write about what breaks and why. Native Spanish, fluent English.

entries.summary: Production operations for a data platform across AWS, GCP, and IBM Cloud. Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana, SLO and error-budget definition, incident response.
Owned a cloud training and demo platform end to end: customer discovery and live demos on one side, vSphere and NSX infrastructure on the other. Cut deployment time 25% with Terraform and Ansible.
Customer-facing architecture engagements. Requirement sessions with CIOs and technical stakeholders, hybrid and multi-cloud design, solution demos, delivery oversight through handoff.
Enterprise Linux and virtualization administration across on-premises and cloud environments. Promoted into the architect role.
Global enterprise Linux administration, VMware virtualization, and automation scripting for monitoring, patching, and provisioning.
Bilingual technical support for networking and connectivity issues, in English and Spanish. Where the twenty years start.
